when I get a request for a new story I go out and buy a new pencil. I only use each pencil for the story it was bought for, when it's over I keep the pencils in a big wooden box. when I'm out of ideas I open the box and go through the pencils. their feel, their smell, even their sound as I tap them on the box has a very calming effect on my mind. I hunt for forgotten boxes of pencils in old bookstores and my favourite are the German *Eberhard Faber* pencils (although I also have a soft spot for fancy Japanese ones from the early 80s).
why do I have so many pencils? because every pencil is a different story.
